recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中多顆中型母細胞，核圓或稍不規則、染色質細緻，細胞質灰藍色、無顆粒，並向一側拉出尾巴狀或手鏡狀突起（pseudopodia），部分細胞質邊緣有小空泡，這些都是 BPDCN 母細胞的典型外觀。
features: Medium to large blasts with high to moderate N:C ratio
Round to slightly indented eccentric nuclei with finely granular chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous
Moderate grey-blue agranular cytoplasm drawn out into tail-like pseudopodia (hand-mirror shapes)
Occasional fine vacuoles along the cytoplasmic periphery
A single segmented neutrophil with normal granulation and red cells with mild anisocytosis
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a population of medium to large blasts with round to slightly indented eccentric nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, and moderate grey-blue agranular cytoplasm. Many cells show characteristic tail-like cytoplasmic protrusions (pseudopodia) and fine peripheral cytoplasmic vacuoles. No Auer rods or cytoplasmic granules are seen. Findings are suggestive of blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm, requiring immunophenotypic confirmation with CD123, CD4, CD56, TCF4 and TCL1.

ddx.vs: Monoblasts often have fine azurophilic granules, folded nuclei and nonspecific esterase or lysozyme positivity, and are MPO/CD14/CD11c positive unlike BPDCN.
Lymphoblasts usually have scant cytoplasm and express TdT with CD19/CD79a or cytoplasmic CD3, lacking strong CD123/TCL1 with CD4 and CD56.
NK leukemia cells have azurophilic granules and express cytotoxic molecules and CD2/CD7 with EBV positivity, but not CD123/TCF4.
